description: Runtime error reporting and incident response for live apps with DebugBundle. Use it for crash reporting, incident monitoring, production monitoring, endpoint health checks, debug bundles and product analytics. Investigate runtime failures, exceptions, logs and observability signals through the CLI primarily, with MCP where needed. Covers application incidents, not generic infrastructure metrics.
